locator_scope.permitted_result: At most one FY2024 original annual-report identity: title, fiscal period, publication date, announcement ID and direct static PDF URL. No PDF body may be opened.

fresh_locator_read_set: the fixed official metadata-only query response
locator_must_not_read_or_write: the FY2024 report body or any other outcome body
selection outcomes, curricula, method packs, price, return, valuation, report or investment recommendation
a company synthesis, a training-effectiveness conclusion, a preoutcome-contract alteration or a broader source inventory
source_selection_rule: Retain exactly one item only if it is the original FY2024 annual report with a first-party static CNINFO PDF URL. Exclude abstracts, English versions, corrections, notices and non-PDF items. If the date-bounded route cannot establish exactly one, return LOCAL_SOURCE_IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED without guessing or widening the query.
